audit_note: Zero additional technical blocks. The mandatory direct observation block is Q_DEPTH and Q_DETECT, additional blocks are cumulative on top of those and may not repeat them, and the V18 frozen constants set qc_metric_count to 2. The adjudicator builds Q_DEPTH+Q_DETECT as the base measurement sensitivity and adds one per registry block, so zero blocks yields exactly the one measurement sensitivity the frozen design specifies. Declaring extra blocks would add models the contract does not call for.
